author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Gameplay Trailer for Red Light On, a hyper-realistic single-player first-person shooter developed by V Games. Players will embody a tactical officer investigating a case that goes awry. Fall back on combat tactics and utilize investigative abilities to seek the truth behind the case. Red Light On is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
title: Red Light On - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Announcement Trailer for BrokenLore: Don't Play, an upcoming first-person psychological horror game developed by Serafini Productions. Players will embody Hideo, a young man who's obsessed with video games and eventually receives an experimental console in the mail. From level to level, Hideo's surroundings in his apartment change as he further descends into madness. BrokenLore: Don't Play is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

#ign #gaming
title: BrokenLore: Don't Play - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the Pre-Alpha trailer for ShatterRush, a multiplayer FPS developed by Tetra Studios. ShatterRush is a high-speed parkour FPS with massive battle mechs and fully destructible arenas. Wallrun, grapple, and smash through cover to outplay your foes in kinetic, high-speed combat as the map changes with every fight. Master momentum to outplay rivals in 16-player combat where the battlefield reshapes every fight. ShatterRush is coming soon to PC (Steam).

#ign #gaming
title: ShatterRush - Official Pre-Alpha Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Powerplex Deep Dive Trailer for Invincible VS, the upcoming fighting game based on the hit comic and Amazon Prime series developed by Quarter Up. Players can get the rundown of the unhinged character of Poweplex, who joins the fight in Invincible VS. Get an in-depth look at the process of development, moveset, techniques, and more about Powerplex. Dish out the rage with Powerplex in Invincible VS, launching on April 30 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Xbox Cloud, Xbox on PC, and Steam).

#InvincibleVS #Gaming #IGN
title: Invincible VS - Official Powerplex Deep Dive Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Lance Weapon Overview Trailer for Monster Hunter Outlanders, a mobile iteration of the hit open-world monster-hunting RPG developed by TiMi Studio Group. Wield the Lance to deal swift thrusts against enemies, which also offers opportunities for blocks and counterattacks. Monster Hunter Outlanders is coming soon to iOS and Android.

author: IGN
description: If you're craving a slow, communications-heavy milsim that respects your time enough to punish you for misusing it, and you don't mind working around some preview-build roughness and a learning curve that hasn't softened much, Hell Let Loose: Vietnam looks like it's still very much itself. That's a good thing if you already loved this series, and a warning if you didn't. Previewed by Gabriel Moss
title: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam Preview: There’s No Hand-Holding in This Milsim FPS

author: IGN
description:
From the long-awaited return of high-speed racing in Forza Horizon 6 to the whip-cracking action of Indiana Jones and the Great Circle on Switch 2, May 2026 is shaping up to be an absolute gauntlet for your gaming backlog. We're diving into the caped crusader's latest adventure in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight and checking out James Bond’s origins in 007: First Light. Whether you’re looking for the nostalgic, cozy-punk vibes of Wax Heads, or the brutal challenge of The Relic: The First Guardian, there is something hitting your platform of choice this month. We’re breaking down some of the biggest games coming this month in hopes that you find a game that is worth your time!

This video covers gaming titles launching in May 2026 across PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, VR platforms, and even mobile! Some highlights this month include the cinematic horror of Directive 8020: A Dark Pictures Game, the stealthy antics of Lego Batman, and the surreal espionage of ZA/UM’s Zero Parade
title: The Biggest Game Releases of May 2026

author: IGN
description:
Saros is a few days out, but the reviews are in… and IGN's 7/10 puts it on the lower end for Housemarque's new PS5 roguelite. The PS5 exclusive doesn't drop until next week, but we've all sunk time into it and we have different opinions, but agree that the gunplay is punchy, the movement (dashing, jumping) feels great, and Carcosa's biomes give you a real sense of place even as the enemies and bosses grind you into dust. But when it comes to build variety and crafting a distinct playstyle? Saros plays it surprisingly straight.
This has us wondering: what actually makes a great roguelite? We dig into what Vampire Survivors, Balatro, Dead Cells, Spelunky, BallxPit, and Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard do that keeps us coming back and where Saros leaves us wanting more. Is it a Returnal successor that lives up to Housemarque’s legacy, or does its polished presentation play to the wrong strengths?

title: Saros Review Discussion: A Solid Shooter That Roguelite Fans Will Likely Rogue-love - Beyond Clips
